fictional_boundary_mountains.note: Fictional unscalable exterior boundary, independent of real DEM. Original invisible sea boundary retained.

local_boundary_outsets.note: User-directed gradual mountain setback outside the Centre/South join

native_cache.note: Derived optional runtime cache; regenerate from binary triangle sources when changing Godot version

notes: Gaussian 20m smoothing is a declared gameplay adjustment, not higher resolution or surveyed road profiles.
Common triangulated field resolves same-level junctions; no independent per-vertex road draping.
Specific vertical geoid and local vertical accuracy not confirmed; no mixing of DEM datums.

source_metadata.vertical_reference: Metres above mean sea level per official product description; specific geoid not confirmed

coast_adjustment.method: OSM shoreline at Y=0; smoothstep transition to CEM; no bathymetry inferred

road_fairing.method: Alternating local triangle gradient projections; shoreline anchors fixed; original slopes below limit unchanged
